functions.name: FProxyMaterialCompiler
functions.docs:
A proxy for the material compiler interface which by default passes all function calls unmodified.
Note: Any functions of FMaterialCompiler that change the internal compiler state must be routed!

functions.name: ShouldStopTranslating

functions.name: GetCompiledShadingModels
functions.docs:
Get the shading models that were encountered when compiling a material's Shading Model attribute graph.
This will represent the actually used Shading Models for a particular material given its static switches, feature levels and material quality for example.
Will return all Shading Models in the material if this is called before that attribute has been compiled.

functions.name: PushMaterialAttribute
functions.docs: Pushes a material attributes property onto the stack. Called as we begin compiling a property through a MaterialAttributes pin.

functions.name: PopMaterialAttribute
functions.docs: Pops a MaterialAttributes property off the stack. Called as we finish compiling a property through a MaterialAttributes pin.

functions.name: PushParameterOwner

functions.name: PopParameterOwner
functions.docs: Pops a parameter owner off the stack. Called as we finish compiling each layer function of MaterialAttributeLayers.

functions.name: PushFunction
functions.docs: Pushes a function onto the compiler's function stack, which indicates that compilation is entering a function.

functions.name: PopFunction
functions.docs: Pops a function from the compiler's function stack, which indicates that compilation is leaving a function.

functions.name: SubstrateTreeStackPush
functions.docs: Pushes a node of the Substrate tree being walked. A node is caracterised by an expression and its input path taken.

functions.name: SubstrateTreeStackGetPathUniqueId
functions.docs:
Returns the unique id of the Substrate tree path, identifying the current node we have reached.
That is used as a unique identifier for each BSDF, recover their Substrate tree operator and apply some simplifications if required.

functions.name: SubstrateTreeStackGetParentPathUniqueId
functions.docs: Returns the unique id of the Substrate tree path for the parent node of the current node position.

functions.name: SubstrateTreeStackPop
functions.docs: Pops a node node of the Substrate tree being walked. Used when walking up the tree back to its root level.

functions.name: GetSubstrateTreeOutOfStackDepthOccurred
functions.docs:
This can be used to know if the Substrate tree we are trying to build is too deep and we should stop the compilation.
This can be used by all nodes taking as input SubstrateData in order to detect node re-entry leading to cyclic graph we cannot handle and compile internally: we must fail the compilation.
